label: D2 after a2->S2 common, following an unrewarded trial not ending in S2, while a2 preference is weak
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S2 by a common transition, after a trial that was unrewarded (prev_reward==0). Those conditions alone have recall 1.0 but precision 0.20 (dev). Precision roughly doubles when the previous trial reached S1 or lies outside the window (tv state -1 != 2; i.e. S1 just went unrewarded, either a1-common or a2-rare), and goes higher again when the policy logit for a2 over a1 at this step is only moderate (choice > -4.44). Dev P=0.46, R=0.69, mass recall 0.89. The unit is silent at D1 and GO, on any reward input, after a1 or in S1, and after rewarded trials. Top activations come from sequences like (a2 S1R r0) then (a2 S2c); activations rise later in episodes. So it seems to fire when the agent has just switched to or confirmed S2 after S1 failed and its preference for a2 is still not strong. Many matching steps stay inactive, so it depends on deeper history that this predicate does not capture. All variables used are observed at D2; choice is the model own output.
